# Incoming-server removal continues cleanup after selected folder and file failures

After validating the server/key, RemoveIncomingServer treats root-folder, descendant enumeration, folder-cache flush and requested file-removal errors as diagnostics so it can deregister the server and clear stored values. Root-dependent work is guarded and a failed descendant enumeration is cleared. New POP3 tests inject throwing removeFiles and rootFolder paths, then directly check registry absence, empty server preferences and retry-server creation. The tests do not directly cover every warning branch or actual disk deletion.

Scope: Account-manager incoming-server cleanup.
